notes.title: The Lumines Arise Demo is Available Now!
notes.content:

[list]
[*] Three-stage single-player Demo (featuring various stages from Journey mode)
[*] Burst Battle online multiplayer mode
[*] Tutorial to learn the basic gameplay of Lumines Arise

Then be sure to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2370000/Lumines_Arise]Wishlist Lumines Arise on Steam[/url], 'cuz we also just announced a release date: November 11, 2025. If you've enjoyed Enhance's game catalog in the past, you're sure to dig this one too.

notes.title: Rez Tips #2: Ultrawide and 4:3 Monitor Support, Best HTC Vive Settings, and more!
notes.content:
Hi again! We hope everyone found our last [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/636450/announcements/detail/1462964134009114567]Rez Tips[/url] post useful. There are many things to unlock in Rez and we don’t want to give away all the secrets just yet ;)

We hope our fans can discuss their progress and achievements in our Steam forums, Twitter, Reddit, or your favorite internet hangout and help those who are curious. We’ve already seen some great screenshots shared on Twitter and our community hub here!

[h1]Ultrawide (21:9) and 4:3 Aspect Ratio Support[/h1]
For those who weren’t with us from the beginning, we heard the rumblings of the community and added support for fans who have 21:9 ultrawide monitors! At the same time, we added 4:3 support.

[img]https://i.redd.it/956mex128bgz.png[/img]
(Thanks to HadynTheHuman on Reddit for the screenshot)


[h1]HTC Vive Auto Rotation and Reticle Settings[/h1]
In VR options we have "Area X auto-camera rotation" ON/OFF. This is ON by default, but turning this OFF will disable the original camera design of Area X where the camera continues to turn in whatever direction you're looking. We also learned many people feel more comfortable setting VR Control Type to Type 2 (use only the controller to move the reticle). To do so, go into VR Options > VR Control Type > Type-2

Some people say that turning Area X auto-camera rotation OFF with VR Control Type-2 works very well on Vive. Please try it out!


[h1]Trance Vibration[/h1]
Did you know you can [i]feel[/i] the gameplay even more in Rez Infinite? In Options > Controls you can turn on Trance Vibration (default is OFF) and connect other controllers to your PC (that support vibration). Enhance the experience more with headphones!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30287715/02658afa065949ba5991b9aed7ceb388a8592bdf.jpg[/img]


[h1]Traveling Mode[/h1]
If you just want to enjoy the environments without worrying about losing your progress, try Traveling Mode to play at your own pace with no game overs. (Notice your player form is green!)

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/xT9IgoKIeIkqFgQPLi/giphy.gif[/img]


More Rez Tips are coming in the following weeks. Let us know in the comments if you have any questions about any modes or features!

notes.title: First-Person Mode, View Mode, and More Rez Tips!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Wow, it’s been a month since launch and as always, we really appreciate your support! Hardcore fans of Rez may have already found these “hidden” features, but these tips can be helpful to those new to the game. Here’s a taste of some things you can do/unlock in Rez Infinite.

Some of these were already announced on our [url=http://twitter.com/enhance_games]Twitter[/url], but there will be more to come!

[h1]View Mode[/h1]
Rez Infinite has a feature called View Mode. While playing in any level, press V on your keyboard, or LB on the gamepad to pause gameplay and look around. In desktop mode, use the left joystick, or hold left click and drag the mouse to look around. In VR, move your head to look around. Exit view mode by pressing V.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l1J3wGARDBMgGuCly/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]3D Depth Settings[/h1]
For more 3D-ness in Areas 1-5, try the new 3D Depth settings under VR Options. “Standard” is the default, and "Increased" and "Max" increases the level of 3D depth, making the environment feel more immersive.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l378bueaPUhcJ8uSA/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]Extra Modes[/h1]
There’s more to Areas 1-5 and Area X! Unlock secret modes and check your progress in the main menu under Rez > Beyond. Have you tried Lost Area?

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3ov9jGUwdFw6jRGUkE/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]New PC Graphics Options[/h1]
Rez Infinite comes with many graphics options to fit your PC rig. Try different settings to see which ones look best.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l1J9OfNsdFiRTDBbG/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]First-Person Mode[/h1]
Are you up to the challenge? Long time players of Rez, the secret of how to unlock it hasn’t changed. Let us know in the comments if you’ve unlocked this special mode!

[img]https://i.ytimg.com/vi/D6_frmFMAK8/maxresdefault.jpg[/img]
(Image from Rez Infinite player [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D6_frmFMAK8]Joseph[/url])

notes.title: Rez Infinite Patch 1.06 (8/29/17)
notes.content:
Right after our trip to Gamescom, we spent some time this week preparing for PAX. (If you're there, find us at the Oculus VR Village.) We're sorry about the delay on these patch notes, but our team heard your concerns, and from what we've been reading, we're really happy the 3D depth setting has been well received so far!

[h1]Rez Infinite Patch 1.06 (8/29/17)[/h1]
[b]--------ISSUES WE ADDRESSED--------[/b]
[list][*]Added “3D Depth” option in VR Settings for those wanting to boost the “3D-ness” of the graphics there. “Standard” is the default and the same as before, so if you want to try it out please go to VR Settings > 3D Depth > and choose either “Increased” or “Max”.
[*]Fixed issue where upper-left-side text was cut off in certain resolutions. 
[*]Adjusted the audio mix / balance of certain sound effects.[/list]
If you have any technical issues and you can't find the answer on our support page or elsewhere in our forums, we’ll be monitoring our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/636450/discussions/1/]Technical Issues Sub Forum[/url].

Thanks as always for supporting us! Have a great weekend :)

notes.title: Rez Infinite Patch Update (8/17/17)
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

Thanks for being supportive during our week of launch. We're really happy that many people have been reporting their issues have been solved!

Since our last news update, we've released two patches (1.04 and 1.05) with 21:9 ultrawide support added and looked into the Area X 3D depth on Oculus VR mode. We also looked into random crashes which hopefully helps those with that issue.

Let us know if these patches worked in the comments, or on our main [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/636450/discussions/0/1471967615864453808/]Technical Support Thread[/url].

[h1]Rez Infinite Patch 1.05 (8/17/17)[/h1]
[b]--------ISSUES WE ADDRESSED--------[/b]
[list][*]Updated the menu cursor handling in menus/results that may have led to an indefinite lock up in the game on certain cases.
[*]Worked on Area X 3D depth in Oculus VR.[/list]

[h1]Rez Infinite Patch 1.04 (8/15/17)[/h1]
[b]--------ISSUES WE ADDRESSED--------[/b]
[list][*]Fixed issue causing crashes on certain video cards.
[*]Added support for 21:9 and 4:3 resolutions. (Please let us know if it works for your setup!)
[*]Worked on audio balance issue.[/list]
[b]--------PLEASE NOTE--------[/b]
[*]If you’re experiencing slowdown, please try adjusting the video settings in-game to find what works best for your setup. (For example, lowering MSAA Filter can often improve performance in Classic Rez.)[/list]

[h1]Rez Infinite Patch 1.03 (8/11/17)[/h1]
[b]--------ISSUES WE ADDRESSED--------[/b]
[list][*]Fixed taskbar showing up on Windows 7 full screen mode when playing on mouse/keyboard.
[*]Fixed X1 and X2 mouse binding not working in Area X.
[*]Worked on the ultrawide monitor issue. Please let us know in the comments if this worked for your setup.[/list]

[h1]Rez Infinite Patch 1.02 (8/10/17)[/h1]
[b]--------ISSUES WE ADDRESSED--------[/b]
[list][*]Fixed issue for some configurations that were having problems (not launching, or crashing repeatedly back to menu, etc.) due to the game not targeting best-performing GPU. We will continue to monitor and work on this issue as needed.
[*]Fixed issue with VR control type 3 where the targeting reticle would disappear when looking behind yourself.
[*]Fixed issue with VR control type 3 where the camera was behaving incorrectly at the Area 2 boss.[/list]

[h1]Rez Infinite Patch 1.01 (8/9/17)[/h1]
[b]--------ISSUES WE ADDRESSED--------[/b]
[list][*] Fixed black screen/display monitor issue. We just released a patch that will hopefully fix the issue related to the display monitor and refresh rate that was preventing you from proceeding. Please confirm if this fixed your issue by replying here. If not, we’ll continue working hard on this.
[*]To those still with the black screen / flashing mouse pointer issue: 

Can you let us your OS/CPU/GPU/Display Monitor specs below and mention this issue?

Can you also try to [url=https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=2037-QEUH-3335] verify your game cache[/url] files?
If a game won't launch, this is often caused by corruption in your extracted game files.

Right-click Rez Infinite in your Steam Library > Properties
Click "Local Content" tab
Click "Verify Integrity of Game Cache..."[/list]

We’ll continue to read posts in our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/636450/discussions/1/]Technical Issues area[/url] in our forums for any other bugs you find. Thanks again for everyone’s support!

[*]Worked on Area X 3D depth in Oculus VR.
[-]Fixed issue causing crashes on certain video cards.

notes.title: Rez Infinite Performance Update With Fixes
notes.content:
Thanks for being active in our forums and supporting us as we troubleshoot technical issues! Your reporting has been a huge help and our dev team is actively listening and looking into reported bugs. Here are some issues we tackled this launch week.

[h1]Rez Infinite Patch 1.01: Black Screen Fix[/h1]
[b]--------ISSUES WE ADDRESSED--------[/b]
[list][*]Fixed black screen/display monitor issue. Hopefully this will fix the issue related to the display monitor and refresh rate that was preventing you from proceeding. We will continue to monitor and work on this issue as needed.[/list]

[h1]Rez Infinite Patch 1.02: Crashing, Disappearing Reticle, Area 2 Boss Camera Fixes[/h1]
[b]--------ISSUES WE ADDRESSED--------[/b]
[list][*]Fixed issue for some configurations that were having problems (not launching, or crashing repeatedly back to menu, etc.) due to the game not targeting best-performing GPU. We will continue to monitor and work on this issue as needed.
